title: 第5章 蚀骨丹的真相第6章 一生的束缚
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
叶羽微微皱起眉头。
虽然只是梦境模拟。
但如果可以的话。
叶羽还是期望能够让梦境中的自己，多活一段时间。
根据上个梦境的失败经验。
可以很轻松的推断出。
活的时间越长，最终评价也会越高。
若是能够成长到合体境，乃至渡劫境的话。
那么结束后，随便奖励一个东西。
肯定就会原地起飞。
实力，才是叶羽想要的保命之法。
【你考虑许久后，决定不再坐以待毙，准备主动出击。
【在锁月楼大举进攻万魂殿的前一天晚上。
【你悄然去往了万魂殿。
【你已经想明白了。
【打算用锁月楼修士的进攻路线，换取蚀骨丹的解药。
【谈的成最好。
【若是真谈不成，再想其他办法。
【你也并不担心会出现什么危险。
【这些年来，你也积攒了两张价值不菲的瞬息符。

【随便一张，都能让瞬间将你转移出千里之外。
【用来脱离危险，再合适不过。
【很快。
【趁着天色黑暗。
【你进入万魂殿内。
content_en:
Ye Yu frowned slightly.
Although it is just a dream simulation.
But if you can.
Ye Yu still hopes to let himself in the dream live for a while longer.
Based on the failed experience of the last dream.
It can be easily deduced.
The longer you live, the higher your final evaluation will be.
If it can grow to the Fusion Realm, or even the Tribulation Realm.
Then when it's over, reward yourself with something.
It will definitely take off on the spot.
Strength is what Ye Yu wants to save his life.
[After thinking for a long time, you decided not to sit still and wait for death, and prepared to take the initiative.
[The night before the Suoyue Tower launched a massive attack on the Ten Thousand Souls Palace.
[You quietly went to the Hall of Ten Thousand Souls.
【You have figured it out.
[I plan to use the Suoyue Tower monk’s attack route in exchange for the antidote to the Bone Corrosion Pill.
[It’s best to talk.
[If the negotiation really fails, think of other ways.
[You are not worried about any danger.
[Over the years, you have also accumulated two valuable instant talismans.
[Any one of them can transport you thousands of miles away in an instant.
[It is perfect for escaping from danger.
【soon.
[While it’s dark.
[You enter the Hall of Ten Thousand Souls.
